name: Capsaicin
aliases: (E)-8-Methyl-N-vanillyl-6-nonenamide, Isodecenoic acid vanillylamide, Qutenza®, trans-8-Methyl-N-vanillyl-6-nonenamide, Zostrix
summary: Capsaicin (8-methyl-N-vanillyl-6-nonenamide) (, commonly ) is a toxin that is the main active component of chili peppers and gives them their distinct pungent, "spicy" or "hot" taste. It is a potent irritant for mammals for which it produces a sensation of burning in any tissue with which it comes into contact.

pharmacology.text: The burning and painful sensations associated with capsaicin result from "defunctionalization" of nociceptor nerve fibers by causing a topical hypersensitivity reaction in the skin. As a member of the vanilloid family, capsaicin binds to a receptor on nociceptor fibers called the vanilloid receptor subtype 1 (TRPV1).

uses.text: A capsaicin transdermal patch (Qutenza) for the management of pain due to post-herpetic neuralgia was approved in 2009, as a therapeutic by both the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and the European Union.

summaryZh: 辣椒素（英語：Capsaicin）又名辣素，辣椒鹼，即反式-8-甲基-N-香草基-6-壬烯醯胺，是辣椒屬植物紅辣椒的活性成分。它對包括人類在內的哺乳動物都有刺激性並可在皮膚中產生灼燒感。
summaryZhHans: 辣椒素（英语：Capsaicin）又名辣素，辣椒碱，即反式-8-甲基-N-香草基-6-壬烯酰胺，是辣椒属植物红辣椒的活性成分。它对包括人类在内的哺乳动物都有刺激性并可在皮肤中产生灼烧感。

sideEffects.en: It causes burning pain, redness and watering wherever it touches. In the eyes or lungs, as with pepper spray, it can cause severe pain, coughing and trouble breathing. Large amounts swallowed can cause stomach pain, vomiting and diarrhoea.
sideEffects.zh: 它接觸到的部位都會出現灼痛、發紅與流淚流液。進入眼睛或肺部時，例如遭到防身噴霧噴到，可能造成劇痛、咳嗽與呼吸困難。大量吞食可能造成胃痛、嘔吐與腹瀉。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它接触到的部位都会出现灼痛、发红与流泪流液。进入眼睛或肺部时，例如遭到防身喷雾喷到，可能造成剧痛、咳嗽与呼吸困难。大量吞食可能造成胃痛、呕吐与腹泻。

fact.en: Birds do not feel the burn of capsaicin because their version of its receptor, TRPV1, does not respond to it. This lets birds eat chilli fruits and spread the seeds, while mammals that would crush the seeds are put off.
fact.zh: 鳥類感受不到辣椒素的灼熱感，因為牠們的 TRPV1 受體對它沒有反應。這讓鳥類可以吃辣椒果實並散播種子，而會把種子嚼碎的哺乳動物則會被辣味嚇退。
fact.zhHans: 鸟类感受不到辣椒素的灼热感，因为牠们的 TRPV1 受体对它没有反应。这让鸟类可以吃辣椒果实并散播种子，而会把种子嚼碎的哺乳动物则会被辣味吓退。
